data.name: Hayaan
data.gender_notes: Hayaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Means 'beauty' or 'grace' in Arabic. Derived from the word 'hayaa' which means 'shyness' or 'modesty'. The name Hayaan carries the meaning “Beauty, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Hayaan usually hope their child will grow to embody beauty, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner beauty and grace of a person.
data.etymology: Hayaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beauty, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hayaan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: حايان
in_arabic.meaning: الحياان هو المُستيقظ من النوم إلى الواجب
